Information.Description: Allyl isothiocyanate is an isothiocyanate with the formula CH2=CHCH2N=C=S. A colorless oil with boiling point 152C, it is responsible for the pungent taste of mustard, horseradish, and wasabi. It has a role as a metabolite, an antimicrobial agent, an antineoplastic agent, an apoptosis inducer and a lachrymator. It is an alkenyl isothiocyanate and an isothiocyanate.
